algorithm: explicit-vector unitary Arnoldi; one chain per coordinate with shared prefixes
reference: lowest Hermitian-projected H Ritz candidate, not certified ground
PF_candidate_sort: increasing absolute energy distance to H-reference
continuation: ascending selected times within each system, previous candidate vector only; no truth tie break
phase_lift: principal arg(lambda)/t + k*(2*pi/t), k=round((E_H_Ritz-principal)/(2*pi/t)); ambiguity from inherited half-period tolerance
residuals: full vector-action residual after unit-circle projection; H reference residual from matching stored H actions
